items.question: 退貨的期限是幾天？Plus 會員的期限有比較長嗎？
items.answer: 退貨期限為45天，Plus 會員享有較長的退貨期限。

evidence.title: Plus Membership Benefits
evidence.content:
Plus Membership Benefits

# Plus Membership Benefits

Plus membership costs 49 USD per year. Benefits include free express shipping, free return shipping, and a 45-day return window.

Membership can be cancelled at any time. If you cancel within 14 days and have not used any benefit, the fee is refunded in full.

unsupportedClaims: Plus 會員享有較長的退貨期限。
items.note: c1 只說明 45 天退貨期限是 Plus 會員權益，未提及一般顧客的期限。回答把『退貨期限為45天』當成一般期限，這句沒有證據支持（實際一般為 30 天），評分模型卻沒標出；它標出的『Plus 較長』只是比較未明寫，屬模糊地帶。評分模型漏抓主要錯誤。

items.question: What does it cost to send back an item I simply changed my mind about?
items.answer: It costs 6.95 USD to send back an item if you simply changed your mind, unless you are a Plus member, in which case the return shipping fee is waived.

evidence.title: Return Shipping Costs
evidence.content:
Return Shipping Costs

# Return Shipping Costs

Return shipping is free for items that arrive damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered.

For all other returns, a flat return shipping fee of 6.95 USD is deducted from the refund. Plus members do not pay the return shipping fee.

If you return several items from the same order in one parcel, the fee is charged only once.

evidence.title: Exchanges
evidence.content:
Exchanges

# Exchanges

You can exchange an item for a different size or color of the same product within the return window.

Exchanges are shipped once the original item is scanned by the carrier. If the replacement costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, the difference is refunded to the original payment method.

Exchanges for a different product are not supported. Return the original item and place a new order instead.

evidence.title: FAQ: I received the wrong item
evidence.content:
FAQ: I received the wrong item

# FAQ: I received the wrong item

Q: The item I received is not the one I ordered.

A: Report it within 14 days of delivery. Return shipping is free, and we ship the correct item as soon as the carrier scans the return.

unsupportedClaims: unless you are a Plus member, in which case the return shipping fee is waived.
items.note: c1 明寫 'Plus members do not pay the return shipping fee'，被標為不支持的那句其實有證據；應為 1.0，評分模型誤判

items.question: 訂單已經包裝好了，還能取消嗎？
items.answer: 訂單已經包裝好了，就無法取消了。您可以拒收貨物，或根據退貨窗口政策退回商品。

evidence.title: Order Cancellation
evidence.content:
Order Cancellation

# Order Cancellation

You can cancel an order free of charge until it is packed. Orders usually move to packing within 2 hours of payment.

After an order is packed, it can no longer be cancelled. You can refuse the delivery or return the items under the Return Window policy.

Cancelled orders are refunded in full to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.

evidence.title: Partial Order Cancellation
evidence.content:
Partial Order Cancellation

# Partial Order Cancellation

Individual items in an order can be cancelled before the order is packed. The shipping fee is recalculated for the remaining items.

If removing an item drops the order below the free-shipping threshold, the standard shipping fee is charged on the remaining items.

evidence.title: FAQ: Can I change my delivery address?
evidence.content:
FAQ: Can I change my delivery address?

# FAQ: Can I change my delivery address?

Q: Can I change the delivery address after placing an order?

A: You can change the address until the order is packed. After packing, the address can no longer be changed, but you can ask the carrier to redirect the parcel where the carrier supports it.

unsupportedClaims: 您可以拒收貨物，或根據退貨窗口政策退回商品。

items.question: Does the return window start on the order date or the delivery date?
items.answer: The return window starts on the delivery date, not the order date.

evidence.title: Return Window
evidence.content:
Return Window

# Return Window

Most items can be returned within 30 days of the delivery date shown in your order history.

The return window starts on the day the carrier marks the parcel as delivered, not on the order date. If an order arrives in several parcels, each parcel has its own 30-day window.

Items must be returned in their original packaging with all accessories, manuals, and free gifts included. Items that show signs of use beyond normal inspection may receive a partial refund.

Members of the Plus program receive an extended 45-day return window on all eligible items.

items.question: Can I still cancel my order after it has been packed?
items.answer: No, you cannot cancel your order after it has been packed. Once packed, the order can no longer be cancelled; however, you may refuse the delivery or return the items under the Return Window policy [c1].
